Symptom
Inspection Point
Reference Page
"Playback Stopped Due to Error Detection" is displayed while playing a specific track
Delete the track that displays the error, record it again and check whether it can be played
If it cannot be played, replace the navigation receiver assembly
"Playback Stopped Due to Error Detection" is displayed when playing any track
Replace Navigation Receiver Assembly
"Recording Stopped Due to Error" is displayed
Operate again, and if the malfunction recurs, replace the navigation receiver assembly
"Cannot Play Because Time Data Is Old. Please Receive GPS" is displayed
Check that the GPS mark is displayed
If the GPS mark is displayed, wait a while, change location and operate again; if the malfunction occurs, replace the navigation receiver assembly
"Cannot Be Used Due to Low Temperature. Please Wait a While Before Use" is displayed
Explain to the customer that the system cannot be used at low temperatures (-20°C or below), so wait until the vehicle interior temperature rises before using it
No sound is output for the sound library only
Replace Navigation Receiver Assembly
CD songs cannot be recorded
Inspect disc (scratches, dirt)
Check that the recording setting is set to AUTO recording
Check that the operation guide or AUTOLIVE is not running (recording stops while they are running)
Check that AUDIO is not OFF (recording stops when AUDIO is OFF)
On the music server information screen, check that the HDD recording function is set to "On"
Cannot edit/delete
Internal processing for G-Library content deletion/license deletion may be in progress, so explain to the customer to wait a while and operate again
No title is assigned to recorded songs
Explain to the customer that no title is assigned when a CD not registered in CDDB, such as a new release, is recorded
Title was displayed during CD playback, but no title is assigned to the song recorded to the HDD

For CD-TEXT compatible CDs, the title display gives priority to that information, but information obtained from CDDB is registered in the sound library, so explain to the customer that no title is assigned when a CD not registered in CDDB is recorded
The title displayed during CD playback differs from the title assigned to the song recorded to the HDD

For CD-TEXT compatible CDs, the title display gives priority to that information, but information obtained from CDDB is registered in the sound library, so explain to the customer that the displayed titles may differ
Song information on the CD jacket differs from the recorded song information
Incorrect information may have been selected during the CDDB search, so explain to the customer to select the "Search HDD" switch on the song information screen and search CDDB again

Move vehicle (to a location where GPS signals can be received)
Remove aftermarket devices that use radio waves
Service inspection (if codes 58-11 and 58-41 are displayed for AVN, take action according to the code)
Check that the navigation antenna cord has no sharp kinks or bends
Check that the cord of the navigation antenna assembly has no sharp kinks or bends
Navigation Check - GPS Information
Replace Navigation Receiver Assembly
